description: This is a C source file related to Git's packing and repacking functionalities. It contains functions for preparing pack objects, handling pack indexes, and managing redundant packs within a repository.

classes.name: struct generated_pack
classes.description: Represents a collection of temporary files for different pack extensions, used during pack creation and installation.

methods.description: Prepares the arguments for the 'pack-objects' command based on given parameters, setting up the child process structure.

methods.name: void pack_objects_args_release(struct pack_objects_args * args)
methods.description: Releases memory allocated for pack objects arguments.

methods.name: void repack_remove_redundant_pack(struct repository * repo,const char * dir_name,const char * base_name)
methods.description: Removes redundant pack files from the repository, potentially deleting associated files.

methods.name: const char * write_pack_opts_pack_prefix(const struct write_pack_opts * opts)
methods.description: Returns the pack prefix string based on given write pack options, ensuring correct path prefixes.

methods.name: bool write_pack_opts_is_local(const struct write_pack_opts * opts)
methods.description: Determines whether the output destination for packing is local based on write pack options.

methods.name: int finish_pack_objects_cmd(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,const struct write_pack_opts * opts,struct child_process * cmd,struct string_list * names)
methods.description: Reads the output from the pack-objects command, verifies object IDs, and finalizes the process.

methods.name: void existing_packs_collect(struct existing_packs * existing,const struct string_list * extra_keep)
methods.description: Populates lists of existing packs, categorizing them as kept, cruft, or non-kept based on their status within the repository.

methods.name: int existing_packs_has_non_kept(const struct existing_packs * existing)
methods.description: Checks if there are any non-kept or cruft packs present.

methods.name: void existing_pack_mark_for_deletion(struct string_list_item * item)
methods.description: Marks a pack for deletion by setting a flag in its list item.

methods.name: void existing_pack_unmark_for_deletion(struct string_list_item * item)
methods.description: Removes the deletion mark from a pack.

methods.name: int existing_pack_is_marked_for_deletion(struct string_list_item * item)
methods.description: Checks whether a pack is marked for deletion.

methods.name: void existing_packs_mark_retained(struct string_list_item * item)
methods.description: Marks a pack as retained, preventing it from being deleted.

methods.name: int existing_pack_is_retained(struct string_list_item * item)
methods.description: Checks if a pack is marked as retained.

methods.name: void existing_packs_mark_for_deletion_1(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,struct string_list * names,struct string_list * list)
methods.description: Marks packs for deletion based on whether their SHA1 hash is not in the list of kept object IDs.

methods.name: void existing_packs_retain_cruft(struct existing_packs * existing,struct packed_git * cruft)
methods.description: Marks a cruft pack to be retained.

methods.name: void existing_packs_mark_for_deletion(struct existing_packs * existing,struct string_list * names)
methods.description: Marks packs for deletion based on a list of kept names.

methods.name: void remove_redundant_packs_1(struct repository * repo,struct string_list * packs,const char * packdir)
methods.description: Removes redundant packs from the repository based on their marked deletion status.

methods.name: void existing_packs_remove_redundant(struct existing_packs * existing,const char * packdir)
methods.description: Removes redundant packs from a repository in a specified pack directory.

methods.name: void existing_packs_release(struct existing_packs * existing)
methods.description: Clears all categories of existing pack lists, freeing associated resources.

methods.description: Creates a new generated_pack object and populates it with existing pack files if present.

methods.name: int generated_pack_has_ext(const struct generated_pack * pack,const char * ext)
methods.description: Checks whether a specific extension file exists for a generated pack.

methods.description: Finalizes temporary pack files, renaming and setting permissions, to install a pack into the repository.
